speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Gastric Cancer.

The combination of significant weight loss (5 kg) over six months, fatigue, and an older age in a male patient is highly suspicious for a malignancy until proven otherwise. While your report mentions a "good appetite," this is atypical for advanced gastric cancer, where early satiety is more common; I suspect the appetite may have diminished as the disease progresses or the weight loss is driven by malabsorption and metabolic changes from the tumor. Given the high pre-test probability, I have already requested a CT Angiogram of the abdomen to evaluate for a gastric mass or lymphadenopathy, and blood work to assess for anemia and organ function. We will proceed with an endoscopy if the imaging supports it.
